description: The pie chart illustrates the "Distribution of data source in the combined training set," displaying a total of 13 distinct categories. There is no separate legend; instead, category labels and their corresponding percentages are positioned outside the chart and connected to their respective slices via thin grey lines with terminal dots. Moving clockwise from the top right, the largest slice is blue and represents NQ at 31.3%. This is followed by a very thin yellow slice for SCIFACT (0.1%), a yellow-gold slice for ENTFA (1.8%), a green slice for FACTCC (2.6%), an orange slice for ANLI (4.6%), and a teal slice for FEVER (16.1%). Continuing clockwise, there is a very thin light purple slice for MULTIFC (0.5%), a light red slice for MULTINLI (11.3%), a thin yellow slice for PUBHEALTH (0.5%), a green slice for SCITAIL (1.2%), an orange slice for SNLI (15.4%), and a light blue slice for VITAMINC (13.0%). Finally, at the top left, there is a small light purple slice labeled XSUMHUL, though its percentage value is visually obscured by a grey rectangular box. The slices do not appear to be ordered by size, and none of the segments are exploded or offset from the main pie.
